title: Ask Richter
subtitle: My Interactive AI CV (Full-Stack RAG Architecture)
summary: Interactive resume powered by hybrid RAG (FAISS + BM25), Node.js/Express, Next.js 15, Turborepo, and a multi-LLM ProviderFactory (Gemini, OpenRouter, HF, and local Ollama).
overview:
The **Ask Richter** project transforms a traditional static resume into an interactive, intelligent conversational experience. Instead of reading a lengthy document, recruiters and technical leaders can converse in natural language with an AI assistant specialized in my professional trajectory.

Conceived under the **SDLC-IA v2.0 Master Framework**, it serves as a production proof-of-concept for a hybrid, provider-agnostic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.

The architecture orchestrates a resilient ecosystem: the Node.js/Express backend hosts the FAISS vector index loaded into memory via Supabase Storage and manages inference through a *Design Pattern Factory*. The application prioritizes Google Gemini as the primary LLM, backed by a transparent fallback chain via OpenRouter, Hugging Face, and zero-cost local inference via Ollama (deepseek-r1:8b). The user interface is delivered via Next.js 15 (App Router) and React 19 on Vercel.
roleDescription: As **AI Solutions Architect & Tech Lead**, I worked end-to-end on the construction and governance of the project, ensuring application lifecycle rigor from RAG architecture design and SDLC governance to Full-Stack development and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
responsibilities: RAG Architecture Design: Modeled data ingestion, chunk sanitization, and hybrid search (FAISS + BM25) to manage +29 software projects and career history.
Governance & SDLC: Instituted strict rules via Constitutional Meta Spec, scope isolation (WSCI), and monorepo orchestration using Turborepo 2.x.
Full-Stack Development: Built reactive frontend (Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind, Framer Motion) and backend (Node.js, LangChain, ProviderFactory).
Reliability Engineering (SRE): Implemented Jidoka / Andon Cord validation pipeline preventing defective commits and fail-fast startup checks for embedding model dimension changes.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Broad Intent Routing where probabilistic vector search failed on complete listing requests.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented a hybrid router triggering deterministic searches via docstore.json for pre-calculated synthetic chunks whenever broad queries (e.g., 'show all projects') are identified.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Monorepo dependency tree conflicts (SSR/Hydration crashes between Next.js 14 and React 18/19).
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Unified and locked strict version parity (Next.js 15.4.2 and React 19.1.0) across all Turborepo workspaces, stabilizing execution on Vercel.

futureEvolution: Planned integration of the Groq engine into the ProviderFactory layer to enable extreme inference acceleration (reducing Time-To-First-Token).
Potential vector storage migration from FAISS in-memory to a fully-managed vector database (e.g., Supabase Vector / pgvector) as content volume scales.
metrics: High Availability via Tiered AI (4 fault-tolerance levels: Gemini ➔ OpenRouter ➔ Hugging Face ➔ Ollama)
Latency & Startup Fail-Fast: Strict manifest.json validation eliminating 100% of silent embedding dimension mismatch errors
Zero Dev Cost: 100% local dev environment running deepseek-r1:8b via Ollama coupled with Google Free Tier cloud infrastructure
RAG Search & Context: Hybrid routing deterministically filtering a catalog of +29 software projects

owaspMitigations.title: Insecure Design (Context Poisoning & Scope Bleed Prevention)
owaspMitigations.description: Boolean validation rules (e.g., isSoftwareProject) preventing scope bleed so certification data is not mixed into project metrics.

owaspMitigations.title: Prompt Injection / DoS & Resource Exhaustion
owaspMitigations.description: Resource abuse control via request rate limiting with exponential backoff mechanisms and seamless fallback chain transitions.

owaspMitigations.title: Cryptographic Failures (Secrets Protection)
owaspMitigations.description: Strict backend abstraction ensuring API keys and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY never leak to the client side, managed in Render and Vercel vaults.
